primary_review: Root source review with independent Terra assessments retained separately
decision: Keep production investigation-v4 and current model selection unchanged. Candidate v5 remains diagnostic only. No pilot acceptance or general model-quality claim.
conditions: Apple M2 Pro, 16 GiB RAM, macOS, local CPU, 8 threads, 8192 context, temperature 0, 1600 output tokens, 240-second soft timeout. Sequential, fixed order, one attempt per case/arm; no retries. Model family, template and quantization details differ as well as parameter count.
limitations: Six synthetic questions, single attempt per arm; consumed after this comparison. No statistical or broader workload claim.
Fixed order and uncontrolled desktop load. Recorded generation/validation durations exclude model load, setup, post-attempt cleanup and human review; not user-perceived or end-to-end latency.
The 240-second timeout is soft: the 8B/v5 conflict attempt recorded about 283 seconds. Worker cleanup and later wall-clock progression may take longer; no hard-stop guarantee.
Both models use the stock installed GGUF template with explicit JSON grammar; this is not a comparison of all supported runtime configurations or a model reasoning benchmark.
Tests and inference ran against the recorded working tree, which includes unrelated existing WIP. The final scoped commit is additionally checked separately.
